2610.13212.title: Beyond Actions: Learning Future Operation Targets for Vision-Language-Action Models
2610.13212.paper_summary: Actions specify what a robot should execute, but do not describe what those commands will achieve. Vision-language-action (VLA) policies nevertheless learn primarily by predicting action chunks from images, language, and state. We introduce Action--Future Coupled Effect Learning (AFCE), which makes a future-grounded physical Effect the policy's primary prediction target. An offline tokenizer constructs temporally ordered Effect tokens from demonstrated actions, realized robot responses, and sparse visual transitions. Reconstruction objectives encourage the representation to retain executable detail and observed physical change. A flow-matching VLA predicts Effects from current images, instruction, and robot state, while a state-conditioned decoder converts them into action chunks. Embodiment-specific interfaces allow single- and dual-arm tasks to share the Effect model. On DexJoCo, AFCE achieves $50.97\%$ overall success, improving over $π_{0.5}$ and UVT by 11.82 and 15.21 percentage points, respectively. It leads on all five bimanual tasks, highlighting the value of Effect supervision for coordinated dexterous manipulation. The project page is available at https://afceproject.github.io/AFCE-Web/.
2610.13212.paper_summary_zh: 行動指定了機器人應該執行的任務，但並未描述這些指令將達成的目標。視覺-語言-行動（VLA）策略仍然主要通過從圖像、語言和狀態中預測行動片段來學習。我們引入了行動-未來耦合效應學習（AFCE），使以未來為基礎的物理效應成為策略的主要預測目標。離線標記器從示範行動、實現的機器人反應和稀疏的視覺轉換中構建時間排序的效應標記。重建目標鼓勵表示保留可執行的細節和觀察到的物理變化。一個流匹配的VLA從當前圖像、指令和機器人狀態預測效應，而狀態條件解碼器將其轉換為行動片段。具體於具身的介面允許單臂和雙臂任務共享效應模型。在DexJoCo上，AFCE達到了$50.97\%$的整體成功率，分別比$π_{0.5}$和UVT提高了11.82和15.21個百分點。它在所有五個雙手任務中領先，突顯了效應監督對協調靈巧操控的價值。項目頁面可在https://afceproject.github.io/AFCE-Web/上訪問。
